samples.question: Four lamps A-D start as shown (filled = ON/1, ring = OFF/0). Read the eight cards from left to right. Purple pips name the control lamp and orange pips name the target lamp; one pip means A, two B, three C, and four D. On each card, if the control is currently ON, toggle the target; if the control is OFF, do nothing. The control itself does not change on that card. What is the final A-D pattern? Answer with four bits in A,B,C,D order, where 1=ON and 0=OFF.
